english:
Every 100 years, the mysterious castle of Sudokuvania appears in the countryside. Legend has it that it contains the Secret of Sudoku. Gathering the last few given digits in the area, you solemnly approach the boxy fortress, determined to discover the secret and share it with your favorite people.
---

Note for SudokuPad: Sudokuvania is best played in a desktop browser.
For the best experience, open the Settings menu and ensure the following settings are enabled:
Experimental > Test Large Puzzle UI: ON
Visual > Draw Arrows Above Lines: ON
Visual > Disable Emoji Replacement: ON

Rules:
Gattai Sudoku - In each square grid, enter digits from 1-N into each row, column, and region, where N is the length of each side of the grid.
Dynamic Fog - The map is covered with fog. Placing correct digits may reveal more clues or rules.
Clues may only be used if their associated rule is uncovered in the Learned Rules panel (in the upper left).
Dynamic Rules - Selecting cells can change the rules displayed in this panel (scroll down to see them); to avoid spoilers, try not to read the rules when a cell covered by fog is selected.
* Select a cell in the map to learn more about its grid, and to get a link to its Boss Puzzle (if applicable).
* Select a rule in the Learned Rules panel for more details.

english:
The castle of Sudokuvania shimmers in the morning air and dissipates with the last of the remaining fog. A short distance away, you trudge up a small hill towards the waiting figure of the Guru. Somehow, you aren’t surprised to see her here.
“The world will never know how you saved Sudoku from those cultists,” she says. “Was it worth it? Did you find what you were looking for?”
You think about the adventures you’ve had and the friends you made along the way, and nod. You may not have found the Secret of Sudoku, but you did gain insight you’ll keep all your life. That, and a sack of gold.
“One more thing,” the Guru calls as you depart. (You wish she would stop doing that.) “Did you remember to turn off the lights before you left?”
Oh, bobbins.

清晨的阳光下，数独魔城微微闪烁，随着最后一缕迷雾散去，整座城堡也渐渐消失。你跋涉一小段路，登上一座低矮的山丘。数独大师正在那里等你。奇怪的是，你一点也不惊讶。
“世人永远不会知道，你是如何从那群狂热分子手中拯救数独的。”她说，“这一切值得吗？你找到自己一直在寻找的东西了吗？”
你想起一路经历的冒险，以及结识的朋友，轻轻点头。你也许没有找到「数独的秘密」，却收获了足以铭记一生的领悟。哦，还有一袋金币。
“还有一件事！”你离开时，大师又喊道。（你真希望她别总这样。）“你走之前，记得关灯了吗？”
哎呀，糟了。

english:
"Nooooooo! It's not fair!" The imp's pleading voice is pitiful, but it can't hide a deceitful tone. Who knows how long this creature has been guiding the course of Sudoku from its seat of power here? You can't allow it to continue.
With the last of the 7x7 grid filled, you stand at the doorway looking down on the defeated monster. Knowing the rest of the castle has also been filled with digits, you take hold of the lines throughout this 7x7 grid and pull sharply; the walls and ceiling instantly collapse onto the once-ruler, caving in the heart of Sudokuvania.

You wearily make your way towards the entryway, and the town outside. What was it all for? You'd never even found a hint of what happened to your father all those years ago. And what will happen to Sudoku if there is no king?

You suddenly become aware of the castle's power, a thrumming heat that had always been there, just behind your conscious mind. You had the sense that... it *wanted* you to stay. It was about to leave this plane of existence, and it needed a ruler. After all, someone had to be in charge of Sudoku--to set the rules and dictate the flows of logic for the puzzling world to solve. And you had proved yourself tonight, hadn't you?

Ann Givens and her father meet you at the front gate of Sudokuvania. They see you smile as you approach, and their own smiles fade as you swing the gate shut between you. Then the castle itself shimmers and vanishes, and they never see you again.

Congratulations! You have conquered Sudokuvania and become the ruler of Sudoku.

Developed by Skeptical Mario

SudokuPad by Sven Neumann

Created with SudokuMaker by sirxemic

english:
Having barely escaped a space-pirate ambush, your damaged ship all but crash lands on unexplored planet Sudoku-45. With all your equipment scattered after the violent entry, and the ship’s navigation system refusing to work, you have nothing but instinct and puzzle solving skills to get you back home.

---

If you're playing this in SudokuPad, consider turning ON the following settings for a better experience:
* Draw Arrows Above Lines
* Disable Emoji Replacement
* Test Large Puzzle UI

This puzzle was heavily inspired by Skeptical Mario's fantastic puzzle "Sudokuvania: digits of despair". Consider checking it out if you haven't.

---

This is a dynamic, expanding puzzle. Selecting a cell will update this description with the rules of that sector.

Most of the grid is covered in fog. By correctly placing digits, the fog may be lifted. You may place digits in the fog if you know what they are, but otherwise avoid clicking on covered cells to not get spoiled by undiscovered areas or rules. 

Each sector is a complete Sudoku of its own. Areas may overlap, in which case the overlapping parts belong to both sectors, but digits entirely within one sector does not affect digits within other sectors (meaning digits can share a row or column as long as they belong to different puzzles).

In the top-right corner is a list of learnt rules. You may only use a clue if you have unlocked it in this list, even if you think you know how it works. You can click on any of the displayed rules to get a more detailed description here.

Most sectors have a boss. When you discover the boss cell (indicated by an emoji), use the link in the sector's description to play the boss puzzle.

---

This is a dynamic, expanding puzzle. More cells, rules and story segments will be revealed as you play.

SECTORS: the grid consists of 16 sectors. Each sector is a separate 9x9 Sudoku puzzle. Normal Sudoku rules apply separately within each sector, but other rules may span multiple sectors.

WALLS: purple cells separated with a border are wall cells. They do not count as part of the grid and Sudoku rules DO NOT apply to them (meaning that some rows, columns and boxes will have fewer than nine digits in them). Do note that if any other clue applies to a wall cell, the cell still needs to contain a digit that satisfies that clue.

HUD: the area to the right is your HUD. It will be updated with new information as you progress through the puzzle. Click on any revealed HUD cell to update this description with information on that particular story entry, rule description or boss link.

BOSSES: there are a few bosses scattered throughout the map. Once you've managed to place a digit in a boss cell the HUD will be updated. Click on that cell to get a link to a separate boss puzzle. Solve it to defeat the boss and progress in the main puzzle by placing the rewarded digit in the boss's HUD cell.

UPGRADES: yellow circles indicate points of interest. If you fill in a circled cell, check the HUD for story updates and new rules.

COSMETIC CELLS: pink cells are identical to their neighbors, the color variation is purely cosmetic.

HINTS: if you get stuck and need help figuring out what to do next, click in the top-right corner to access a secret list of vague objectives for each story moment.

这是一个会随着游玩不断扩展的动态谜题。新的格子、规则和剧情会陆续揭晓。

**区域（SECTORS）**：棋盘分为 16 个区域，每个区域都是独立的 9×9 数独。标准数独规则分别适用于各区域，但某些其他规则可能跨越多个区域。

**墙壁（WALLS）**：以边框隔开的紫色格子是墙壁格，不属于标准数独棋盘，不受数独规则约束（因此某些行、列或宫可能少于九个数字）。不过，如果有其他线索涉及墙壁格，仍须填写满足该线索的数字。

**状态面板（HUD）**：棋盘右侧为状态面板。随着解谜进展，面板会显示新信息。点击已经揭示的面板格，可在这里查看对应剧情、规则说明或首领链接。

**首领（BOSSES）**：地图各处散布着数位首领。当你成功填入一个首领格的数字，状态面板便会更新。点击相应面板格取得独立首领谜题的链接。解开首领谜题后，将奖励的数字填入首领在状态面板中的格子，才能继续推进主线。

**升级（UPGRADES）**：黄色圆圈表示值得调查的地点。填入圈内格子的数字后，检查状态面板，获取剧情更新和新规则。

**装饰格（COSMETIC CELLS）**：粉色格与周围格子没有规则上的差异，颜色只是装饰。

**提示（HINTS）**：如果卡住，不知道接下来该做什么，可点击右上角查看按剧情顺序排列的隐秘目标提示清单。

english:
Sudoku - In each NxN grid, enter a digit from 1-9 into each cell without repeating in a row, column or region.
Most grid's regions are 3x3 boxes.
Digits can repeat in a row or column as long as they are in separate grids.

Dynamic Fog - Entering the correct digit in a cell may clear some fog. No guessing is required.

Learning Rules - Clues have no meaning until the associated rule is uncovered from the fog. Select a rule in the Learned Rules panel for more information.

Boss Puzzles - When you uncover a Boss Cell (😈), click the link to the associated Boss Puzzle below (must have a cell in its grid selected).
Solving the Boss Puzzle will give the digit to be placed in the Boss Cell.

Outside the Map - Cells outside of any grid do not need to contain any digit; or, they may contain the digit 0, as necessitated by nearby clues.
All clues must be correct, even those outside the map.
zhHans:
数独——每张 N×N 网格的各格均填入 1 至 9；同一网格的同一行、列或区域内不得重复。
多数网格使用 3×3 宫。
如果两个格子分属不同网格，即使它们在同一大地图行或列，数字也可以重复。

动态迷雾——在格子中填入正确数字，可能会驱散部分迷雾。无需猜测。

学习规则——对应规则从迷雾中揭示之前，线索不具备任何效力。选中「已学会的规则」中的规则可以阅读详情。

首领谜题——发现首领格（😈）后，先选中它所属网格中的一个格子，再通过下方链接挑战首领谜题。
解开首领谜题后，即可得知应填入首领格的数字。

地图之外——不属于任何网格的格子不必填写数字；根据附近线索的需要，也可能填入 0。
所有线索都必须成立，包括地图外的线索。

english:
Blink cells teleport you to a 'destination cell' indexed by the blink cell's row or column in its grid.

A blink cell contains either horizontal or vertical bars, and two short arrows; the arrows point at the nearest cell containing the value N in any orthogonal direction, where N is the blink cell's row number in the current grid if there are blue horizontal bars, or the blink cell's column number if there are red vertical bars.
There will always be one nearest cell, meaning no ties, and the blink cell itself cannot contain N. However, the destination cell may lie in a different grid than the clue.

满足条件的最近格子一定恰好只有一个，不会平局，而且闪烁格自身不能含有数值 N。不过，目标格可以位于另一张网格。

english:
The walls of Sudokuvania's vault are lined with lockboxes. This must be where the secret of Sudoku is kept, but you have other goals in mind.

Sudoku - Place a digit from 1-9 into each cell without digits repeating in a row, column, or 3x3 box.

Vault cells - Gold vault cells must contain a value greater than the value in every orthogonally-adjacent cell, unless the adjacent cell is also a vault cell.
zhHans:
数独魔城的金库墙上嵌满了保险箱。数独的秘密一定藏在这里，可你心里还有更重要的目标。

数独——每格填入 1 至 9；同一行、列或 3×3 宫内的数字不得重复。

english: The... the whole town is... empty! Please find my father and the rest of the townspeople inside the castle!
zhHans: 那……整个镇子都……空了！求你到城堡里找到我爸爸和其他镇民！

[点击这里挑战首领](https://sudokupad.app/sudokuvania/boss-saving-grace).

english: Thick smoke billows out from a previously hidden storage chamber. It solidifies into a terrifyingly familiar form...\n[Click here to fight the boss](https://sudokupad.app/sudokuvania/boss-through-the-ringer).
zhHans:
浓烟从先前隐藏的储藏室中滚滚涌出，凝成一个熟悉得可怕的形体……
[点击这里挑战首领](https://sudokupad.app/sudokuvania/boss-through-the-ringer).

english:
This is the Primary Quest Line; adjacent values on the line must sum to a prime number.

Ann Givens has vanished from Rowsville -- Use the Pen Tool to draw this Quest Line yourself! From the circle at Ann's previous location, create a line that moves orthogonally and which follows this rule until it reaches the other circle (note: The path is not necessarily unique). This Quest Line may overlap other Quest Lines, but still may not cross itself.
Your research indicated that an outdoor location is required for the ritual; perhaps there is a Balcony somewhere high up that you had previously missed...
zhHans:
这是主线任务线：线上任意两个相邻格子的数值之和必须是质数。

安·已知数在行之村失踪了——请使用「画线」工具，亲自绘制这条任务线！从安原本位置的圆圈出发，沿水平或垂直方向前进，遵循这条规则，直到抵达另一个圆圈（注意：路线不一定唯一）。主线任务线可以和其他任务线重叠，但仍不能与自身交叉。

english: This Quest Line is a Between line; values on the line must be strictly between the values in the two end points of the line.
zhHans: 这条任务线是一条「夹心线」。线条中间所有格子的数值，都必须严格介于两个端点格子的数值之间。

english: This Quest Line is a German Whisper line; adjacent values on the line must differ by 5 or more.
zhHans: 这条任务线是一条「德式耳语线」。线上任意两个相邻格子的数值之差，必须至少为 5。

english:
This Quest Line is a Region Sum line; as the line passes through grid regions [boxes], the values on each segment of the line in a region all sum to the same number.
Segments can overlap if a cell is in regions of multiple grids. If the line leaves a region and re-enters it, that becomes a different segment.

The far end of this quest is in the Royal Quarters, on the eastern side of the castle.
zhHans:
这条任务线是一条「区域和线」。每当线条穿过某个网格的区域（宫），其在该区域内形成的每一段上，所有格子的数值之和都相同。
如果一个格子同时属于多个网格的区域，不同线段可以在此重叠。如果线条离开某个区域后又进入该区域，则重新进入的部分算另一段。

这项任务的终点位于城堡东侧的王室寝宫。

english: This Quest Line is a Split Pea line; the values between two waypoint circles sum to a concatenation of the values in those two circles.\nFor example, if two waypoint values are 8 and 1, the cell values between them must sum to either 18 or 81.
zhHans:
这条任务线是一条「豌豆拼接线」。两个路径点圆圈之间的格子数值之和，等于把这两个圆圈中的数值按某种顺序拼接而成的数字。
例如，两个路径点分别为 8 和 1，则它们之间的格子数值之和必须是 18 或 81。

english: This Quest Line is an interval Zipper line. From the line's center cell (marked with a star), extending in both directions, each pair of cells marked with squares have values that sum to the value in the center cell.\nCells on the line without marks are not affected by the line.
zhHans:
这条任务线是一条「间隔拉链线」。从标有星星的中心格向两个方向延伸；每对标有方块、以中心对称的格子，其数值之和必须等于中心格的数值。
线上没有方块标记的格子，不受这条线的限制。

english:
This seemingly empty room appears to lead towards the Royal Quarters. You feel at a loss, as numbers have no effect on your surroundings.

Cipher Cages - Each value from 0-9 corresponds to a different letter. Red cages indicate where letters should be placed rather than digits. This cipher is the same throughout the castle.

Ciphered Sudoku - Place a set of six distinct values from 0-9 into each row, column, and 3x2 box; in all cells except those which overlap with other grids, use letters (there is a red cipher cage around those cells). Make sure the Letter Tool is enabled!
Cells with a cage labeled with a letter contain that letter.
zhHans:
这个看似空无一物的房间似乎通向王室寝宫。你感到束手无策：不管填什么数字，四周都毫无反应。

密码笼——0 至 9 的每个数值都对应一个不同字母。红色笼表示此处应填写字母，而不是数字；整座城堡共用同一套密码。

密码数独——每行、每列及每个 3×2 宫中，填入从 0 至 9 选出的六个互不相同的数值。除了与其他网格重叠的格子，其余格子必须填写字母（这些格子外围有红色密码笼）。记得启用「字母」工具！
标着字母的笼内格子，须填写该字母。

english: This windy precipice outside one of Sudokuvania's high towers was easy to overlook. It seems you've made it just in time for the ritual, but are you in time to stop it?\n\nSudoku - Place a digit from 1-6 into each cell without digits repeating in a row, column, or 2x3 box.
zhHans:
城堡一座高塔外的悬崖风势猛烈，很容易被忽略。看来你刚好赶上仪式……但还来得及阻止吗？

数独——每格填入 1 至 6；同一行、列或 2×3 宫内的数字不得重复。

你看见四个壮汉围着火坑而坐，旁边地上有一个年轻身影，似乎被绑住了。

english:
You've followed the "Spirit of Sudoku"--really just an inky devil with a big ego--into its cramped hiding place deep into the heart of the castle. Time to end its reign of terror once and for all.

Squishdoku - Place a digit from 1-9 into each cell without digits repeating in a row, column, or 3x3 box; the nine 3x3 boxes overlap such that cells in rows 3 and 5, and columns 3 and 5, are in multiple regions.
For example, r1c3 is in both box 1 and box 2; r5c5 is in boxes 5, 6, 8, and 9.
zhHans:
你一路追踪所谓的「数独之灵」——其实不过是个自视甚高的墨黑恶魔——来到城堡深处那个狭小的藏身之所。是时候彻底结束它的恐怖统治了。

挤压数独（Squishdoku）——每格填入 1 至 9 的数字，同一行、列或 3×3 宫内不得重复；九个 3×3 宫彼此重叠，第 3 行、第 5 行以及第 3 列、第 5 列中的部分格子属于多个宫。
例如，r1c3 同时属于第 1 宫和第 2 宫；r5c5 同时属于第 5、6、8、9 宫。

english: Your friendship with the gargoyles means they can be persuaded to give you clues.\n\nA 🗿[gargoyle] adjacent to a grid's row or column has a number which is the sum of the first X values in that row or column starting from the clue, where X is the value in the cell nearest to the clue in the row/column.
zhHans:
你与石像鬼建立的友谊，让它们愿意提供一些线索。

位于网格某行或列旁的石像鬼图标（🗿）带有一个数字，表示从线索方向开始，该行或列最前面 X 个格子的数值之和。其中 X 等于该行或列最靠近线索格子的数值。

一座巨型水坝横亘在双峰之间，为下方反应堆提供水力发电。水流湍急，靠得太近可能被冲走。

english:
Adjacent digits along green VINES must differ by at least 5.

Example: 1-7-2-9-4

Hints:
5 can never appear on a vine.
Because of this, digits must alternate between being high (>5) and low (<5).
There are only four digits in each group: 1,2,3,4 and 6,7,8,9.
Digits close to 5, in particular 4 and 6, are harder to place as they have fewer possible partners.
zhHans:
绿色藤蔓线上相邻两个数字之差至少为 5。

示例：1-7-2-9-4

提示：
数字 5 不可能出现在藤蔓线上。
因此，数字必须在大于 5 和小于 5 的两组之间交替。
这两组分别只有四个数字：1、2、3、4 与 6、7、8、9。
越接近 5 的数字，尤其是 4 和 6，可配对的数字越少，越难放置。

english: All lines within the DISCOTHÈQUE are PARITY LINES. Adjacent digits along the lines must alternate between odd and even. This applies to all clues in the sector.
zhHans: 迪斯科舞厅内的所有线条都是奇偶交替线：沿线相邻数字必须奇偶交替。本区域所有线索都遵守此规则。

english: All rows, columns and diagonals of the SHRINE must sum to 15.
zhHans: 神殿中所有横行、竖列及两条对角线的数字之和都必须为 15。
反马步与反王步

english:
Digits along a PARTY LINE must alternate between being odd and even.

Example: 2-3-8-1-2

Hints:
There are only four even digits and five odd ones.
zhHans:
派对线上相邻数字必须奇偶交替。

示例：2-3-8-1-2

提示：
偶数只有四个，奇数则有五个。

english:
Digits along a TARGETING ARROW must sum to the digit in its circle.

Example: 1+2+3=6

Hints:
9 can't go on an arrow and 1 can't go in a circle, unless the arrow's is just one cell long.
Digits CAN repeat if the arrow passes multiple boxes.
The sum can never be larger than 9.
zhHans:
瞄准箭头上的数字之和必须等于圆圈内的数字。

示例：1+2+3=6

提示：
除非箭头仅有一格，否则 9 不能位于箭头上、1 不能位于圆圈里。
如果箭头跨越多个宫，数字可以重复。
箭头上的总和不能超过 9。

english:
Digits an equal distance from the middle of a BALL CHUTE must sum to the digit in the middle.

Example: 1-3-5-2-4 => 1+4=5 and 3+2=5

Hints:
These lines are always an odd length so there is always a middle cell.
9 can only ever appear in the middle of the line.
You can never have a pair of digits that are 5 or higher.
zhHans:
在滑球槽中，距中间格距离相等的两格，其数字之和必须等于中间格的数字。

示例：1-3-5-2-4，即 1+4=5 且 3+2=5

提示：
这些线条始终具有奇数个格子，因此必有中间格。
数字 9 只能出现在中间格。
一对数字不可能同时大于或等于 5。

english:
Digits must increase along THERMOMETERS, with the lowest value appearing in the round bulb.

Example: 1-2-4-7-9

Hints:
1 can only appear in the bulb and 9 on the tip.
This means a box full of thermometers may limit where they go.
A digit along a thermometer may restrict either of its neighbors.
zhHans:
温度计上的数字必须从圆形球部开始严格递增，球部为最小值。

示例：1-2-4-7-9

提示：
1 只能出现在球部，9 只能出现在末端。
因此，同一宫内有许多温度计时，会限制数字的位置。
温度计上的一个数字也可能限制它左右相邻的数字。

english:
Digits separated by a white SCAN dot differ by exactly 1.

Example: 1-2, 4-3, or 7-6

Hints:
If a cell is connected with two dots and both other cells see each other, they must form a trio, e.g. 1-2-3.
1 and 9 can never be in the middle of such strings.
If the chain moves into another box it's possible there could be repeated digits, e.g. 1-2-1.
zhHans:
白色扫描点两侧的数字必须恰好相差 1。

示例：1-2、4-3 或 7-6

提示：
若一个格子连接两个点，且两侧另外两个格子彼此可见，这三个格子必须构成连续的三个数字，例如 1-2-3。
数字 1 和 9 不可能位于这种连续三格的中间。
如果链条进入另一个宫，就可能出现重复数字，例如 1-2-1。

english:
Digits within a KILLER CAGE must sum to the value in the top-left corner. Digits may not repeat in a cage, even if it stretches across multiple boxes.

Example: 1+2+3=6

Hints:
It is often useful to consider what the largest or smallest sum achievable is, or if any digit must be included to reach a certain sum.
It is also useful to consider the digits outside a cage.
Each 9-cell box sum to 45.
Under Advanced settings you can enable a Killer Calculator to see all digit combinations of a cage.
zhHans:
杀手笼内数字之和必须等于左上角给出的数值。同一个笼内的数字不得重复，即使笼子跨越多个宫也一样。

示例：1+2+3=6

提示：
考虑笼内可能达到的最大、最小总和，以及为了达到某个总和是否必须包含特定数字，通常很有帮助。
也可以考虑笼外的数字。
每个九格宫的数字总和为 45。
可在高级设置中启用“杀手计算器”，查看笼子的全部数字组合。

english: Digits within the FORTRESS must not repeat within a chess king's move (one cell, diagonally) or a chess knight's move (two cells in one direction and one perpendicular to it).
zhHans: 堡垒内的数字不得在国际象棋的王步（向任意方向移动一格，包含斜向）或马步（沿某方向移动两格再垂直移动一格）范围内重复。

The digit in the arrow cell indicates how many cells you should jump in the arrow's direction. The value of the cell you land in is the same as the connected diamond cell.

english:
The digit outside the grid indicate how many digits in that row or column are "seen" from that direction, if larger digits block the view of smaller ones behind them.

Hints:
A 9 would mean it sees every digit. Conversely, a 1 means the highest digit must be adjacent to the clue.
If you know where the 9 is, you can count the number of available cells.
A 2 in the clue means the 8 must either be next to the clue, or behind the 9, with no other option.

english:
For each ARROW clue, draw a line in the direction of the arrow, starting in the cell with the arrow's head and with length equal to the circled value at the arrow's base.

Digits along the line have to be a set of consecutive digits in any order (without repeating digits).

If the line would hit a wall, it instead bounces by rotating 90 degrees away from the wall. Notably, it does so inside the cell itself, rather than moving to the cell's corner and bouncing there. It also doesn't cut corners and will bounce instead. The line is not allowed to go straight into a wall (or diagonally into an opposing corner). If it does, it has to be short enough to stop before hitting the wall.

If you want an example, look [here](https://sudokupad.app/7asln8p2u1)
zhHans:
对每一个箭头线索，从箭头尖端格开始，沿箭头指示方向画一条线，线条长度（以格子计）等于根部圆圈里的数字。

沿线数字必须组成一组连续整数，顺序不限，且数字不得重复。

如果线条即将撞上墙壁，必须转向远离墙壁的一侧，旋转 90 度后继续延伸。注意，转向发生在当前格内，而不是先走到格子顶角再折返；线条也不能切过墙角，遇到墙角必须转向。线条不得直接走进墙壁，也不能沿对角方向撞上相对的墙角；若会撞墙，线条就必须短到刚好在撞上前结束。

需要示例时，请看[这里](https://sudokupad.app/7asln8p2u1)。

For each blue water cell, there must be at least ONE water cell among the eight surrounding cells that differs by exacly 1.

(Note that pink or red cells are cosmetic and if they are surrounded by water cells, they too count as water. BREAKABLE cells do not count as water.)
In order to break through BARRIER lines, each set of three digits along the lines must contain a low, middle and high digit (123, 456, and 789 respectively), in any order.

In the rubble right next to where you woke up, you find a still intact power cell that used to belong to your suit. You slot it in and can’t help a sigh of relief as the now fully-powered nanobots start buzzing about, repairing and improving joints and platings. Soon, your suit shines orange, and that means it’s now immune to lava!

Inside the center of the geode is a seed. You can’t make any sense of it, so you bring it back to the refugee camp in the hope that someone there knows what to do with it.

They do, and it causes quite a stir. This mystical beanstalk seed grows to amazing heights when planted. With this, you can finally reach the uppermost layer of the planet again!

Starting in the refugee camp in Sector 7 (the yellow circle), draw an 8 cell long VINE straight up. Digits along the VINE differ by at least 5.
Large steel constructions tower over a dry lakebed. Pipes and chutes criss-cross up the sides and you spot multiple abandoned shacks, bolted haphazardly to the walls.

People celebrate! For once, you've managed to win without destroying the planet in the process. Wark's doomsday weapon is no more and his minions are surrendering in droves.

The people of the refugee camp thank you, their leaders already busy trying to fill the vacuum left by the madman's fall and peace is being restored across the planet. You join them for a feast, get your fair share of back pats, but before long you're back in the cockpit once again.

You're a drifter after all, and this puzzle is solved. Time to set out for new adventures, to worlds unseen!

Sudoku rules do not apply to purple wall cells, they may contain any of the digits 1-9, or no digits. Formally, the Sudoku constraint of the sector is satisfied if no row, column or box contains repeated digits, excluding all wall cells.

Do note that if any other clue applies to a wall cell, the cell still needs to contain a digit that satisfies that clue.

The barrier shatters and water comes flooding out, as a well-timed explosion tears through the weak spot in the concrete dam. You watch in wonder as the lakebed is once again filled with water. Color all non-wall cells in Sector 10 blue, up to the dashed line. They are now considered water cells and follow underwater rules.

The heat is intense as you step up onto the slopes of an active volcano and your ailing suit struggles to keep up. Smoke and steam billows out from heat vents in the ground. You feel the earth tremble slightly.

The steel construct looms ever tall above you. You've climbed high, but it still stretches on, further than you can reach. Beyond a not too distant hill, you spot smoke. Whether it's trouble or relief remains to be seen. You've no doubt yet to see the last of Wark's minions.

The tower is strange, seemingly made entirely from a single piece of some dark, unknown metal. There are no seams or joints in the surface, yet somehow you still manage to climb it, thanks to your newfound abilities.

In a room near the top you find sketches of several mysterious glyphs and RUNES. According to some hastily scribbled notes, someone once used this room to study them.

The volcano erupts! Draw a line from each of the two dots above the lava (row 5, column 5 and 6). The lines may move diagonally and may cut corners, but may not cross heat vents or wall cells. They also cannot cross or intersect with each other. The lines must cover all orange dots and behave like slow inverse thermometers (digits along the lines must decrease or stay the same as you move away from the volcano).

The wind howls as it sweeps across the jagged overhang that makes up this particular cliffside. You ride the current of hot air generated by the volcano. There is seismic activity going on here as well, and you're kept on your toes as you weave between lava plumes and billowing smoke.

Wall cells separated by a black FAULT LINE must have a 1:2 ratio (similar to black kropki dots).

You blast your way through a crack in the wall. On the other side is an underground bunker and research facility. You don't get much time to take in the sight as moments later, an emergency blast door shuts right in your face. You're not getting through this one any time soon so you leave it for now.

You come across another abandoned research station. This one was in decent condition before you flooded the place and a few machines still refuse to give in, despite the room being completely submerged. You recognize a DRG mining probe and manage to download a mapping of regional FAULT LINES to your suit.

You descend into the firey inferno that is the innards of the volcano. Visibility is absolutely rotten and you're sweltering inside your suit. Still, your scanner says there's a key to be had here, and by this point you have nothing else to go on when it comes to finding your way back home, so into the volcano we go!

You discover a research station. Geological surface scans show an intricate network of heat vents. You copy their thermal mappings indicating how to ride the updrafts from these “inverse thermometers” as the researchers seem to call them.

You don’t strike gold. Instead, you emerge inside a geode of tall, orange crystals. The brittle gemstones surround something in the center, but navigating the sharp edges is tricky. To retain their structural integrity, each row and column of a CRYSTAL CAGE must sum to the value in the top-left corner.
You emerge in a dry and dusty field and are greeted by a wave of hot air. Wrecks and debris from some long forgotten battle dot the landscape.

You emerge inside the underground bunker. Complex machinery relay data metrics back and forth from various points of interest around the planet. Despite the vicinity to an erupting volcano, the air is surprisingly cool.

You feel the dampness through your suit as you emerge underwater in a large basin. The wreck of an old space ship lies at the bottom, but the large hole in the hull makes it clear it’s never going to fly again.

You find people. Refugees, huddling in a small, makeshift camp. They greet you warmly, once they realize you’re not one of Wark’s goons. The warmongering alien is using the planet as a base for his conquest of the solar system, forcing its people to scavenge for the dangerous, old technology of their ancestors to use as advanced weapons.

The people in the camp are trying to escape their oppressors, but resources are running low. You promise to help, but reaching Wark’s fortress up on the cliffs above will be near impossible. The camp’s elders hand you a suit upgrade and suggest you explore the nearby water basin. It’s been untouched by scavengers due to the number of deadly predators living there and may still contain something of use. You steel yourself for what lies ahead.

You hit the jackpot beating this guy! You access the memory banks of the wrecked dragon, revealing a map to buried treasure that Wark was no doubt trying to get his claws on.

To find the treasure cell within sector 13 (in the bottom left corner), draw a horizontal line from one of the keys and a vertical line from a second key. The value of third key goes into the cell where the two lines meet.

You land on Cell-81, the hidden homeworld of the ancient Puzzlo race. Your ship perches precariously atop the steep cliffs that make up the topmost layer of the planet. The foliage is dense up here, hiding your ship from view. Time to find out who broadcasted that emergency signal.

You manage to salvage a half-decent MISSILE launcher from a large, crab-like exoskeleton. Despite the rust and mismatching interfaces, you quickly get the optical targeting system back in working condition.

You manage to sneak a peek at Wark’s base of operation. It’s a disheartening sight: the base is heavily fortified, and there are plenty of those barriers that almost broke you before. You will need an edge to deal with them before you stand any chance at defeating Wark and his army. (You just found Wark's base, but it might still be a long time before you're strong enough to confront him. Don't be alarmed if you have plenty of logs left to find.)

You step into a dimly lit chamber. On a pedestal, under a single, bright spotlight, lies a suit unlike any you’ve seen before, the light seemingly inverting as it bounces off the polished metal surface. This is the PHASE SUIT. Read the unlocked rules carefully!

You wake up at the bottom of a ravine. Faint daylight seeps down from cracks in the ceiling, illuminating your surroundings enough that you can navigate. Your suit is badly damaged and almost all of your equipment is broken or offline. Your scanner still works, as do your trusty gardening gloves, so you should be able to climb your way out.

You walk up to the largest console and start mashing buttons at random, prompted by your suit’s AI. With some guesswork (and a conveniently placed sticky-note with all the important passwords), you manage to transfer access to the base’s remote controlled DRONES to you, allowing you to use them as platforms when exploring.

You’re in luck! Among the fire and brimstone, the volcano has spit out an upgrade cache that must have fallen into the caldera long ago. Inside the cache lies a slightly singed MORPH BALL upgrade, complete with fire decals.

You’ve found it! There is a way to break through the barriers if you vary the frequency just right across the width of the fields. Armed with this insight, you’re unstoppable! You toggle your missile launcher to butt-kicking mode and march for the enemy stronghold. Time to end this!
You've made a puzzle out of the rules table and even managed to solve it!
You've managed to actually solve a puzzle that should have been impossible!

Your ship still stands where you left it. It seems that despite their boast, Wark's goons were either unable to get the ship to fly, or they were busy failing to chase you down. Either way, it's a relief to see the ship still in one piece.

But you can't leave just yet. You have unfinished business with Wark, and until they're dealt with there's no way you'll leave the refugees behind.
